components.name: AP / Product / Project card
components.description: Project-card publication status and cover state are independent. With no coverAssetId the nested AP / Media / Project cover uses State=Default-mascot at rest. With an uploaded asset it uses State=Added bound to that image. Editable hover/focus reveals State=Empty; leave/blur recomputes from the current asset. Cover actions are separate from Open project and never change publication status. Branding upload instead uses Empty as its no-cover resting state. See the native component implementation guide.

components.name: AP / Media / Project cover

variants.name: State=Empty
variants.description: Upload/edit affordance. Default for branding when no cover is uploaded; transient hover/focus visual in editable cover areas. Never use as the resting fallback for homepage cards. Clicking invokes upload/replace for the same project; leaving restores the saved asset-derived state.

variants.name: State=Default-mascot
variants.description: Homepage-card fallback when coverAssetId is absent. Preserve the supplied mascot artwork. Editable hover/focus shows Empty; leaving restores this fallback. Do not use this variant as the empty branding-upload control.

variants.name: State=Added
variants.description: An uploaded cover exists. Bind the actual project cover asset and preserve its crop. In editable home/branding contexts show Empty temporarily on hover/focus. Restore this uploaded image on leave/blur. Read-only visitor covers stay Added without an upload action.

components.description: Three presentation variants: Empty, Added, Default-mascot. Homepage cards: no uploaded asset => Default-mascot at rest; uploaded asset => Added bound to that asset. Editable hover/focus temporarily shows Empty and restores the asset-derived rest state on leave/blur. Branding upload: no asset => Empty at rest; uploaded asset => Added, with Empty on hover/focus. Hover never changes coverAssetId. Read-only/visitor contexts do not expose upload affordances.
